workspace.suggested_summary: Machine-first lead opportunity scoring API for CRMs, AI agents and workflow automations.
workspace.suggested_description: MachineSignal lets automated systems create a limited sandbox key, score business domains, request beta deliverables, simulate sandbox checkout and reconcile test credits without a human sales conversation. The public workspace is for sandbox evaluation only. It does not execute real payments, issue fiscal invoices or contact external targets.

environment_variables.name: api_key
environment_variables.note: Set after POST /v1/sandbox/customers. Never publish a real key.

recommended_collection_order: Order deep analysis after strong score
Order action pack after confirmed opportunity

publication_copy.headline: Lead opportunity scoring API built for machine buyers.
publication_copy.one_liner: Create a sandbox key, score leads, buy beta deliverables and simulate checkout without talking to sales.
publication_copy.short_pitch: MachineSignal is a sandbox-callable API for automated lead scoring, target discovery, Deep Analysis and CRM-ready Action Pack payloads. It is designed for CRMs, AI agents and workflow systems that need structured decisions before spending enrichment, campaign, CRM or agent budget.

acceptance_gates_before_public_visibilit: Postman collection imports without missing URLs.
Postman public collection smoke test is passed.
Sandbox customer creation returns a key.
Score, purchase-intent and order retrieval work with the sandbox key.
Payment-test sandbox intent and reconciliation work.
Workspace text clearly says sandbox only and no real payments.

current_import_readiness.blocker: Postman login session required before Codex can import into the account.
current_import_readiness.public_visibility_blocked_until: final in-Postman secret scan and owner approval

human_approval_required_for: Making the workspace public if it exposes account-level settings.
Publishing terms, pricing or legal commitments outside sandbox.
